commonWish.title: From all of us
commonWish.body:
Fortunately, we all are in Pune. Happy birthday Supreethaa - lucky we get to enjoy your smile and this pleasant evening.

We all typed something separately, nobody coordinated, and somehow everyone said the same thing in a different way. You'll read them in a minute. Good luck figuring out who said what.

recap: We've made you guess people five times.
finale.turn: But beneath all of that, there is something very simple.
body: You are the person everyone in this group thinks of first - when something funny happens, when something awful happens, when something needs a second opinion at 1am.
This whole silly game exists because nobody could think of a normal way to say what you already know: that being your friend is one of the easier, warmer things in our lives.
Another year of you. We're glad about it in a way that doesn't fit into a message box.
